You scan the room for a chest drawer, and you find a chest drawer. You can make out an antique trunk. You can make out a king-size bed. But the thing is empty. This always happens!

There is a closed wooden door leading east.

thought: I should go east through the wooden door to explore more rooms where I might find an apple and a way to grill it.
feedback: You have to open the wooden door first.
